plain: We're not responsible for any indirect losses, like lost profits.
legal: The Provider shall not be liable for any indirect or consequential loss, including loss of profits.

plain: The most we'll ever have to pay you is what you paid us in the last 12 months.
legal: The Provider's aggregate liability hereunder shall not exceed the total fees paid by the Client during the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

plain: This limit doesn't apply if someone gets hurt or dies because of our negligence.
legal: Nothing in this Agreement shall limit or exclude liability for death or personal injury caused by negligence.

plain: You'll cover us if someone sues us because of something you uploaded.
legal: The Customer shall indemnify and hold harmless the Provider against any third-party claim arising from content uploaded by the Customer.

plain: We'll defend you if someone claims our software infringes their patent.
legal: The Provider shall defend the Customer against any third-party claim alleging that the Software infringes a patent.

plain: You have to tell us quickly about any claim so we can handle it.
legal: The indemnified Party shall give prompt written notice of any claim to the indemnifying Party so as to enable it to conduct the defense thereof.

plain: You can't settle a claim in our name without asking us.
legal: The indemnified Party shall not settle any claim on behalf of the indemnifying Party without its prior written consent.

plain: The product is provided as is, with no guarantees.
legal: The Product is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind.

plain: We don't promise the service will never go down.
legal: The Provider does not warrant that the Service will be uninterrupted.

plain: You use the app at your own risk.
legal: The User's use of the Application is at the User's sole risk.

plain: Neither of us is responsible for delays caused by things like floods, wars or strikes.
legal: Neither Party shall be liable for any delay caused by events beyond its reasonable control, including floods, war or strikes.

plain: The tenant is responsible for damage they or their guests cause.
legal: The Tenant shall be liable for any damage caused by the Tenant or the Tenant's guests.

plain: We aren't liable for items left in the locker room.
legal: The Club accepts no liability for items left in the locker room.

plain: You must have insurance that covers at least $1,000,000 per claim.
legal: The Contractor shall maintain insurance providing coverage of not less than $1,000,000 per claim.

plain: Send us a copy of your insurance certificate before starting work.
legal: The Contractor shall furnish a copy of its certificate of insurance prior to commencing the Works.

plain: Claims must be brought within 2 years of the problem happening.
legal: Any claim shall be brought within two (2) years of the occurrence of the event giving rise thereto.

plain: You'll pay us back for any fines we get because you broke the rules.
legal: The Supplier shall reimburse the Company for any fines imposed upon the Company as a result of the Supplier's non-compliance.

plain: Each party is only liable for its own mistakes.
legal: Each Party shall be liable solely for its own acts and omissions.

plain: Riders take part in the event at their own risk and can't sue the organizers for injuries.
legal: Participants take part in the Event at their own risk and waive any claim against the Organizers for personal injury, to the extent permitted by applicable law.

plain: If the goods are faulty, we'll replace them or refund you, and that's all.
legal: In the event that the Goods are defective, the Seller shall, at its option, replace the Goods or refund the purchase price, which shall constitute the Buyer's sole remedy.

plain: We're not responsible for problems caused by you changing the software.
legal: The Provider shall not be liable for any defect arising from modifications made to the Software by the Customer.

plain: The landlord isn't responsible for the tenant's personal belongings.
legal: The Landlord shall not be responsible for any loss of or damage to the Tenant's personal property.

plain: The driver is responsible for all parking tickets during the rental.
legal: The Hirer shall be liable for all parking penalties incurred during the rental period.

plain: We won't be liable if your data is lost, so keep your own backups.
legal: The Provider shall not be liable for any loss of data, and the Customer shall be responsible for maintaining its own backups.

plain: Our warranty lasts 12 months from delivery.
legal: The warranty shall remain in effect for twelve (12) months from the date of delivery.

plain: The warranty is void if you open the device.
legal: The warranty shall be void if the Device is opened or tampered with.

plain: The contractor is liable for any damage they do to the property while working.
legal: The Contractor shall be liable for any damage to the Property caused in the course of performing the Works.

plain: You agree that $500 is a fair estimate of our loss if you miss the deadline.
legal: The Parties agree that $500 represents a genuine pre-estimate of the loss that will be suffered in the event of a failure to meet the deadline.

plain: Liability for data breaches is capped at three times the annual fees.
legal: Liability arising from any data breach shall be limited to three (3) times the annual fees.

plain: The guide isn't responsible if you ignore their safety instructions.
legal: The Guide shall not be liable for any injury resulting from a Participant's failure to follow safety instructions.

plain: We'll pay for repairs if our movers break anything.
legal: The Company shall bear the cost of repairing any item damaged by its removal personnel.

plain: You must report damage within 48 hours of delivery or we won't accept the claim.
legal: Any damage shall be reported within forty-eight (48) hours of delivery, failing which no claim shall be accepted.

plain: Nothing in this contract limits rights you have by law as a consumer.
legal: Nothing in this Agreement shall affect the statutory rights of the Customer as a consumer.

plain: Members are personally responsible for any equipment they borrow.
legal: Each Member shall be personally responsible for any equipment borrowed by that Member.

plain: Parents are responsible for supervising their children at all times.
legal: Parents shall be responsible for supervising their children at all times.

plain: We aren't liable for advice given by third-party experts on our platform.
legal: The Platform shall not be liable for any advice provided by third-party experts through the Platform.

plain: The seller guarantees the car has no outstanding loans on it.
legal: The Seller warrants that the Vehicle is free from any outstanding finance or encumbrance.

plain: The buyer accepts the house in its current condition.
legal: The Buyer accepts the Property in its present condition.

plain: If both of us are partly at fault, the loss is shared based on how much each of us contributed.
legal: Where a loss is caused partly by each Party, liability shall be apportioned according to each Party's relative contribution thereto.

plain: You'll protect the company from any claims caused by your breach of this agreement.
legal: The Employee shall indemnify the Company against all claims arising from the Employee's breach of this Agreement.

plain: We're not responsible for websites we link to.
legal: The Company accepts no responsibility for the content of any linked third-party website.

plain: You're liable for everything done using your login.
legal: The User shall be responsible for all activities conducted using the User's login credentials.

plain: The organizer may cancel the event due to bad weather without being liable.
legal: The Organizer may cancel the Event due to adverse weather conditions without incurring any liability.

plain: Refunds won't be given for events cancelled due to circumstances beyond our control, but we'll try to reschedule.
legal: No refund shall be given for events cancelled due to circumstances beyond the Organizer's control; however, the Organizer shall use reasonable efforts to reschedule such events.

plain: The hotel is not responsible for valuables not left in the safe.
legal: The Hotel shall not be liable for the loss of any valuables not deposited in the safe.

plain: We'll fix any bugs you report during the first 90 days free of charge.
legal: The Developer shall correct, free of charge, any defect reported within ninety (90) days of delivery.

plain: The supplier guarantees the materials meet the agreed specifications.
legal: The Supplier warrants that the Materials conform to the agreed specifications.

plain: You can't claim for the same loss twice.
legal: No Party shall be entitled to recover more than once in respect of the same loss.

plain: We aren't responsible for delays caused by the shipping company.
legal: The Seller shall not be liable for any delay attributable to the carrier.

plain: Any claim under this warranty must be made in writing.
legal: All claims under this warranty shall be submitted in writing.
